category: IP geolocation API and database download

free_tier.stated: IPinfo Lite: unlimited API requests with no daily or monthly limit, free forever with no credit card; country and continent geolocation plus ASN number, name and domain; the same Lite data as a daily database download (4,380,245 lines; CSV, MMDB, JSON and Parquet)
free_tier.notes: city-level fields need IPinfo Core (USD 26 a month, 150k requests a month) or the legacy ipinfo.io endpoint, which answers without a token and is limited to 50k requests a month

per_object_cap.stated: the batch endpoint enriches up to 1,000 IPs per call; the Lite MMDB file is 25.12 MB

interface_detail: HTTPS GET api.ipinfo.io/lite/{ip}?token=TOKEN (also v4. and v6. hosts), POST api.ipinfo.io/batch/lite with a JSON array of up to 1,000 IPs; the Lite files at ipinfo.io/data/ipinfo_lite.{csv.gz,mmdb,json.gz,parquet}?token=TOKEN. Without a token the Lite API answers HTTP 403 Unknown token and the Lite file HTTP 401; the legacy ipinfo.io/{ip}/json answers without a token with city-level fields
tooling: any HTTP client (curl), any MMDB reader for the database file, the vendor's mmdbctl tool
chaining: one free account gives unlimited country and ASN lookups over the API and the whole Lite dataset as a daily file for local lookups at any rate; city-level data comes from the paid Core plan or from the legacy keyless endpoint at 50k requests a month. Bulk path: the daily Lite database download, plus the 1,000-IP batch endpoint

limits.value: up to 1,000 IPs per batch call
none on IPinfo Lite (no daily or monthly limit); 50k requests a month on the legacy keyless API; 150k a month on Core

binding_note: Lite has no request quota and no concurrency cap, and the batch cap only sizes a call; what limits it is depth, country and ASN only

identity_cost.detail: an IPinfo account with first name, last name, email and password, or GitHub sign-in; no credit card

reliability_note: the legacy keyless API may be discontinued; paid plans answer HTTP 429 past their monthly quota; no rate limit is published for Lite
confidence_note: the pricing, Lite API, Lite database, developer and signup pages were quoted on 2026-10-30; keyless requests were probed (legacy API HTTP 200 with city fields, Lite API HTTP 403, Lite file HTTP 401). No account was opened, so no keyed Lite lookup or file download was made; one would move it to measured.
